headline: US Treasury Moves to Block Crypto Exchange MEXC Over Alleged Illicit Finance
summary: The U.S. Department of the Treasury has taken action to cut off cryptocurrency exchange MEXC, citing over $16 billion in alleged illicit financial flows linked to Russian finance and anti-Iran enforcement.
why: The U.S. Department of the Treasury regulates financial institutions and enforces international economic sanctions.

impacts.name: MEXC
impacts.why: U.S. Treasury enforcement actions restrict access to financial services and user operations.
